behavior_problem_id: train-only asymmetric next-item transitions may be poorly represented by a single global Euclidean hierarchy
next_item_hypothesis: A frequent train-only successor may be separated from its anchor at the first SID level by content-only global quantization. Train-transition-informed residual assignment tests whether first-level alignment improves without making Stage2 a ranker. Observed asymmetry motivates but does not prove this failure or curvature benefit.

math_definition.mechanism: One global residual vector-quantized item SID builder: content embedding maps items to 32-dimensional latent vectors; three shared codebooks of 256 vectors produce one global three-token SID per item. Train-only successor-distribution supervision shapes representations. Stage2 does not rank next items.

geometry.scored_distance: D^2(x,y)=d_c(x,y)^2=(1/c)*arcosh(1+2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)))^2; the objective uses squared distance in both arms.
geometry.stable_arcosh: Let u=2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)); compute arcosh argument as max(1.0,1.0+u), equivalently u=max(0,u), with no positive floor. Compute arcosh(1+u)=log1p(u+sqrt(u*(u+2))). delta=0.0; never clamp to 1+delta for positive delta.
geometry.domain_and_maps: Both arms use the identical closed fixed ball ||x||<=R=0.9 for every vector entering distance. Curved projection first enforces radius (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c), epsilon=0.1, then the common fixed ball; flat projection uses only the common fixed ball. Curved exp_0(v)=tanh(sqrt(c)||v||)*v/(sqrt(c)||v||), with zero limit 0. At c->0, D^2 tends exactly to 4||x-y||^2 (unsquared d tends to 2||x-y||), exp_0 becomes identity, and (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is undefined, so the flat arm applies the common fixed-ball projection instead. The distance formula's c->0 limit is evaluated by its continuous limit, not division by zero.
geometry.residual_operation_order: At each level: map residual to scored space (exp_0 when c>0, identity at c=0); project to the common fixed ball (curved arm also enforces curvature radius before common projection); assign nearest code by D^2 with lowest-index tie break; subtract selected code in tangent coordinates. Every residual update is projected by this map-then-project sequence before it is scored at the next level.
geometry.shared_domain_control: Same implementation, architecture, parameter count, initialization, codebook initialization, optimizer, schedule, seeds, minibatch order, data and budget; only curvature parameter c changes, with flat arm the c->0 limit.

math_definition.assignment_gradient: Forward SID assignment is hard argmin; backward uses explicit straight-through estimator: selected-code quantizer output has identity derivative with respect to its mapped residual and zero derivative through the discrete index. Reconstruction and successor losses therefore reach encoder representations; commitment and codebook terms have explicit gradients to encoder and selected entries.

objective.anti_collapse: Train-successor distribution loss L_succ enters total loss with coefficient 1. It compares representations against detached, potentially distinct train-only successor distributions, so mapping every item to one code cannot fit non-identical targets; content reconstruction additionally anchors representations.

losses.name: content_reconstruction
losses.equation: L_rec=(1/N) sum_{i in I} D^2(z_i, Dec(q_i))
losses.tensors_and_shapes: z and Dec(q) are N x 32; q_i is the three-level residual quantized output; I is frozen training item set, N=|I|.
losses.normalization_and_empty_rule: Mean across I; empty I yields zero and invalid run.
losses.gradient_and_target_rule: Both distance inputs are mapped/projected; straight-through assignment carries gradient. No validation/test target.

losses.name: train_successor_distribution
losses.equation: L_succ=-(1/|A|) sum_{a in A} sum_{t in T_a} stopgrad(P_a(t))*log softmax_{u in T_a}(-D^2(z_a,z_u)/tau)_t; P_a(t)=C_a(t)/sum_{v in T_a}C_a(v), tau=1.0
losses.tensors_and_shapes: z is N x 32; C_a(t) are train-only transition counts; A={a:sum_t C_a(t)>0}; T_a={t:C_a(t)>0}; each score/target vector has |T_a| entries.
losses.normalization_and_empty_rule: Normalize each nonempty target distribution, then uniformly average over A; exclude anchors with no successor. Empty A gives zero and invalid run.
losses.gradient_and_target_rule: P is fixed detached train-split count data, not parameter-dependent; this breaks circularity. Scores backpropagate through both representations. No batch negatives.

losses.name: commitment_and_codebook
losses.tensors_and_shapes: h_il and selected code e_{l,k_il} are 32-vectors; i ranges over N training items and l=1,2,3.
losses.normalization_and_empty_rule: Sum levels per item and average over I; empty I gives zero and invalid run.
losses.gradient_and_target_rule: First term updates selected code entries; second updates h through straight-through. stopgrad breaks assignment/code target circularity.

objective.total: L=L_rec+L_succ+0.25*L_vq; coefficients and tau are frozen.

hyperbolic_necessity: Negative curvature is a motivated, falsifiable hypothesis rather than established necessity. Branching, non-reversible train successor neighborhoods may need expanding representational volume to distinguish diverging directions while preserving coarse shared prefixes. Aggregate asymmetry alone does not prove this; paired flat geometry tests the claim.
euclidean_control: Same implementation and objective at c=0: squared distance 4||x-y||^2, identity exponential map, common fixed-ball projection. Identical architecture, parameter count, initialization, codebooks, optimizer, schedule, seeds, data and budget.
effect_site: Stage2 item-SID assignment: first-level anchor/successor alignment and level-two/three residual refinement. Stage3 T5 alone ranks next items.
real_trigger_measurement: Train-only longest-prefix-per-user transitions: 339519 transitions, 323633 directed pairs, 24556 items, 57439 users; mean next-item entropy 4.844072338042215 bits; no observed reverse events for 314605 pairs (fraction 0.9266197178950221). Motivation only, not validation/test supervision or causal evidence.
training_only_inputs: Frozen item content and train-split transitions from results/stage0_build_parquet/train.parquet, SHA-256 80597e38d081029e57e7434c92ff7be2c872f82aebc2e5f072ef973d73e88815. Exclude validation/test behavior, future events, prediction-time user context and batch composition.

protocol.protocol_freeze: Keep repository-frozen Stage2 epochs, batch size, schedule and codebook initialization unchanged. Exactly one paired training/evaluation seed: [42]; no seed dropping; across-seed aggregate is arithmetic mean over this exact list. Stage2 validation uses the frozen 52855 pairs (one positive and ten negatives per anchor), seed 42, history[-1]->target. Stage3 read-only evaluation is the test.parquet artifact produced by the same frozen Stage0 build manifest; bind to its recorded SHA-256 and frozen authorized Stage3 T5 ranking protocol. For each arm and seed, compute binary hit@10 per eligible test example, uniformly average over all eligible examples, then compute paired curved-minus-flat difference and arithmetic mean over exactly [42]. Missing artifact hash or authorized ranking protocol yields NULL; no substitution. Test interactions are never fitting, target, selection or tuning inputs.

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_l1_hard_er
stage2_diagnostics.direction: curved strictly above frozen Resample reference 16.38953942232631 and paired flat
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Per registered seed compute using frozen validation definition; compare arithmetic-mean curved value over exactly [42] to reference and arithmetic-mean paired difference over exactly [42] to zero.

stage2_diagnostics.name: level2_distinct_prefixes
stage2_diagnostics.direction: curved strictly above frozen reference 16145 and paired flat
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Count unique (k1,k2) over all items per seed; compare curved arithmetic mean over [42] to reference and paired arithmetic-mean difference over [42] to zero.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3_refinement_gain
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Per seed mean defined log2 bucket ratio over all items, then arithmetic-mean paired difference over [42].

stage2_diagnostics.name: conditional_G3
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Use supplied alpha=1,K=256 estimator on each frozen validation pair; average finite pair values per seed and paired differences over [42]; no-restricted-successor pair contributes zero.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3_collision
stage2_diagnostics.minimum_effect: at least 0.001 absolute share decrease paired flat-minus-curved
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Per seed share of items with repeated full SID; arithmetic-mean paired flat-minus-curved over [42].

stage3_behavioral_test.seed_rule: Use only test.parquet bound by frozen Stage0 manifest and SHA-256 and authorized frozen Stage3 T5 protocol; uniformly average eligible-example binary hit@10 per arm and seed, then paired difference and arithmetic mean over [42]. No test use for fitting or selection.

classification.falsified_if: Any registered criterion is finite and fails its registered direction/minimum_effect or required frozen-reference comparison.
classification.passed_if: Every registered criterion is finite and satisfies its registered direction/minimum_effect and required frozen-reference comparisons.
classification.mixed_if: At least one finite criterion satisfies and at least one other finite criterion fails its registered direction/minimum_effect, with no NULL comparison.

null_outcome_rule: If a seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite (including zero denominator, missing evaluation, or empty stratum), classify NULL. Any comparison containing a NULL seed is inconclusive, neither passed nor falsified; never omit that seed.
